title: Vendors page opens without the Reports permission
refs: SV-8682 (Custom Roles & Permissions §Vendor & Order Management — View grants Vendors/Purchase Orders/Deliveries visibility)
preconds:
1. You have a role with these permissions turned ON: Vendor & Order Management → View, and See Financial Data.
  2. The Reports permission is turned OFF for that role.
  3. A user is signed in with that role.
expected:
The Vendors page opens normally and shows the vendor list.

You are NOT sent to an "Access restricted" / Access Denied screen.

Opening Vendors does not require the Reports permission — Vendors access depends only on Vendor & Order Management → View.
